attributes.descriptionHtml:
I’m Twizzler named after the black licorice candy and just as sweet. I came to PAWS with a bad wound on my paw. Antibiotics helped a lot but I still lost one toe. That doesn't slow me down. I still jump and climb with no issue

Just like black licorice is an acquired taste, I take my sweet time to decide if I feel safe with you so I need a kind caring patient adopter.  I am shy with new people but I like other non-aggressive  kitties. I even sleep with my foster and she can pet me then or when I am eating. Treats? Yes please! I love them but in moderation of course.

My ideal home will be quiet and calm, no little kids or dogs please. I don't want to be distracted from my favorite pastime of gazing out the window.

attributes.descriptionHtml:
I am Mila, a sweet high energy calico girl of 1 yr but am more like a kitten. I am very playful and might like a feline buddy to chase and horse around with. My best playmate would be someone as energetic as me. Toys, toys, toys - keep 'em coming especially the ones with catnip!

As exuberant as I am, I will be pretty shy at first. I need to trust you before I will warm up much to pets and attention but I've become quite fond of my foster and like to be around her

The best way to win my over is with food and treats. Not too much but it's definitely a key to success.

My foster mom has a gentle mellow cat friendly dog. He's ok but I don't think I'd like to be around a young or super active or noisy dog.

My front paws are huge, more like mitts. I'd love to meet you.

attributes.descriptionHtml:
Age: Approx. 3 years old

Breed: Domestic short-hair

Size: Large (Approx. 14 lbs)

Litter box trained: YES

Story/background:

Roo was a stray–someone got him neutered and then moved away a year later and left him behind. Roo fended for himself for a year against coyotes, other stray cats, and other dangers. When the new residents moved in, they were horrified to find out Roo’s backstory, and have been caring for Roo until now! Roo is a TALL and big boy, but was very skinny at first. He is now healthy and happy, and is excited to get a new home with his very own humans!

About me:

Roo is a low-maintenance gentleman who absolutely loves to receive pets (and food)–don’t worry, he will pay for your services in endless cuddles and purrs! Roo doesn’t know that he is a big boy, and is happiest when sitting in your lap or laying down with you. He does enjoy sitting in a window with a view and staring outside, but so far has not been very interested in play.

 

He is enjoying feeling safe and secure indoors and has been catching up on his beauty rest with his temporary humans! Roo is extraordinarily affectionate and works hard making biscuits and providing ample “boops” to humans in exchange for regular meals, cuddles, and litter box cleanings. When he feels comfortable with you, Roo will drool some when purring, but this is a HUGE compliment because this means he is very content and happy!

Adoptable in: MA

Good with dogs: Yes, with proper intros
Good with cats: Yes
Good with kids: Yes (13+)
Crate trained: Working on it
House trained: Yes

Meet Ace of Hearts: Professional Cuddle Bug and Neighborhood Watch Captain

Looking for a best friend with a big personality, an even bigger heart, and enough charm to make you smile every single day? Meet Ace, an adorable, affectionate, slightly goofy guy who's ready to steal your heart (and probably your spot on the couch)!

Ace is the perfect combination of playful goofball and champion couch potato. He's always up for a game of fetch, tug-of-war, or chasing his flirt pole, and he takes his stuffed animal collection very seriously. But when playtime is over, he's equally happy sunbathing in the yard, chewing on a favorite toy, or curling up next to his humans for some quality snuggle time. He's a moderate-energy guy who loves a nice walk on a sunny day but is perfectly content to binge-watch Netflix with you when the weather doesn't cooperate.

One of Ace's most endearing qualities? He takes his job as Chief Family Supervisor VERY seriously. On walks, he likes to make sure everyone in his group is accounted for. No human left behind! He's also quite the conversationalist and has been known to greet people with his signature howl. Whether he's excited, happy, or simply has something important to announce, Ace isn't afraid to use his voice. He's basically a furry little town crier that loves to yap with the girls!

Ace enjoys canine companionship and tends to appreciate calmer, more easygoing dogs. With proper introductions he can make wonderful dog friends. He also enjoys meeting new people once he's had a chance to get comfortable. Ace can be vocal with unfamiliar humans and can be reactive toward unfamiliar dogs when introductions are rushed, so he appreciates someone who understands that good friendships don't always happen in the first five seconds!

And don't let that adorable face fool you. There's a very smart cookie behind those puppy-dog eyes! Ace is house-trained, does great sleeping in his crate overnight, and is working hard on his daytime crate training. He's eager to learn, loves having a job to do, and is highly motivated by treats. Give this boy a little structure, some clear expectations, and a pocketful of snacks, and he'll happily show off his potential!

Now, Ace does have a few requests for his forever home. He's a sensitive soul underneath all that silliness, and sudden noises, unpredictable movements, and too much commotion can make him uneasy. His dream home would be a quieter, adult-only household where life is a little more predictable and his humans understand the value of patience, routine, and clear boundaries. He's also an enthusiastic alert barker, so a home with fewer sights, sounds, and traffic would help him relax.

Ace loves his people deeply, and being separated from them can be tough. He's making progress with his separation anxiety in his foster home, but he'd thrive with someone who's home more often than not and willing to continue helping him build confidence and independence. A single-family home, or another living situation where his occasional vocal performances won't upset the neighbors, would be ideal.

Here's the thing about Ace: he doesn't need a perfect home or a perfect human. He just needs the right one. Someone who will appreciate his silly side, celebrate his progress, respect his sensitivities, and give him the stability he needs to truly shine.

And once you're part of Ace's inner circle? You've got a devoted best friend who will make sure you're never lonely, never unaccounted for on a walk, and never short on snuggles.

Ace has so much love to give and is ready to find the person who will give him the same in return. Could you be the happy ending he's been waiting for?

*Ace is part of our Foster to Adopt (FTA) program.*

Please Note: All dogs are posted until they are officially adopted. This dog may have other interested adopters in line. If you are interested in adopting, please fill out an application on our website at www.lasthopek9.org.

Zaria is an affectionate, and loyal girl with a real zest for life. She is a medium energy dog who enjoys a play session, followed by a nap. 

She benefits from slow introductions to other dogs. She would also be fine as an only dog. Zaria happily entertains herself with toys or a romp in the backyard. She has lived with cats and has for the most part ignored their presence. Zaria loves her people and enjoys making new human friends. She can be an enthusiastic greeter and sometimes forgets her size, so older dog-savvy children would be best for her. Zaria enjoys going for walks around the neighborhood and looks to her humans for reassurance and guidance in new situations. 

Zaria is an intelligent girl and very eager to please. She knows a plethora of commands, and loves to learn new things every day. She is fully house trained and crate trained. Zaria enjoys relaxing in her crate throughout the day and sleeps soundly in it overnight. She is looking for an experienced and patient adopter who will continue to provide her with structure and routine so she can continue to be her best self. 

Are you the lucky family who gets to add Zaria to your bunch?

attributes.descriptionHtml:
** work in progress cat **

I'm Carbon, a handsome black cat with a hint of "smoke", and luxuriously long fur. I enjoy being near you and will quietly follow you around like your own shadow. I keep you company in my own gentle way. Although I'm not that into laps, my foster has started to pet me. I love bird-watching from the window. And I LOVE playtime. I'll use my scratching post, then stare at you until you play with me. Oh, and I think treats are great, always handy to know while I'm acclimating to new surroundings. Also - if you have a mouse problem in your house, I'm your guy! Real mice are even better than toys!

I am a "work-in-progress" cat. When I first came to Carmah, I was extremely shy but the volunteers saw possibilities in me. My foster and I have been making progress together. I want to find a home where I have the space and time to continue the process. When I first move to your home, I will probably hide while I get used to household rhythms, smells, sounds, and routines. I will slowly come out of my shell as I learn to trust you. I may always hide when new people arrive, or I might start to enjoy their company as well. I will reward your patience with loyalty and companionship.

I am 3 years old and in great health. If you’re looking for a calm, low-maintenance companion who will keep you company without being overly demanding, I am the perfect match.

I am Valora, a beautifully elegant girl. My name means courage. I was mom to my last litter of kittens, and I was so gentle with them. Now that they are grown, it is my turn to shine. I am playful. I love wand toys, and because I thrive on routine, I will remind you when it’s time to play! I'll take a while to warm up and may even hide. ** Work in progress cat **

I am Valora, a beautifully elegant girl. My name means courage. I was mom to my last litter of kittens, and I was so gentle with them. Now that they are grown, it is my turn to shine. I am playful. I love wand toys, and because I thrive on routine, I will remind you when it’s time to play! I'll take a while to warm up and may even hide. But be reassured that I am always gentle, never aggressive. I adore other friendly playful cats.

I need a patient, experienced cat owner who can give me time to blossom. Once I feel safe, I'll quietly curl up on your legs at night. Although a welcoming cat would help me blossom, I have no known exposure to dogs. And older, gentle children would be fine.


I am a "work-in-progress" cat. When I first came to Carmah, I was extremely shy but the volunteers saw possibilities in me. My foster and I have been making progress together. I want to find a home where I have the space and time to continue the process. When I first move to your home, I will probably hide while I get used to household rhythms, smells, sounds, and routines. I will slowly come out of my shell as I learn to trust you. I may always hide when new people arrive, or I might start to enjoy their company as well. I will reward your patience with loyalty and companionship.

I am Nani Thayer! I am playful and affectionate, the "shy sweetheart." Give me a little time and I will blossom into a loyal and affectionate companion. I can be adopted with Stitch or into a home that already has a young welcoming cat.  I am good with dogs. I have one in my foster home and we coexist peacefully.

I am 5 months old and in great health. I am sweet as the day is long. Got room in your heart for me?

I am an excited ball of fur with a big grin. My perfect match would be someone who loves to be outside, whether hiking, running, playing ball, or just being active and having fun.

I don’t mean to brag, but people tell me I’m a lot like @JasonTatum of the Celtics because I have stunning athleticism and am completely devoted to those I love - like my family members.

When I’m not admiring your every move, I’d love to be playing with other dogs. So, what do you say? Wanna be besties and play ball?

attributes.descriptionHtml:
I'm Scraps, a big ol' softie. I LIVE for belly rubs and for soaking up all the love. I might politely ask you for attention, and I'm equally happy for you to come looking for cuddles. I may be a little shy at first - just give me some time to acclimate to my new surroundings and I'll be good to go! Did anyone say Playtime? I'll chase a string or laser like it’s my life’s mission, pounce on unsuspecting feet from under the bed, and zoom after my BFF Elvira with thunderous footsteps.

Speaking of Elvira, we are a package deal! We love to wrestle, cuddle, chase, and we will absolutely entertain you. Together, we are the perfect combo of playful chaos and sweet companionship.

I am FIV+ but that should not be a worry. With attentive vet care - the same that Carmah would ask for any cat - I can live a good long and healthy life. And there is no danger to Elvira or other house cats.

We are 2 years old and in perfect health. If you’re ready for a pair of hilarious, lovable, belly-rub-seeking companion kitties who keep each other happy - and will keep you entertained, we are your duo!

attributes.descriptionHtml:
** work-in-progress cat **

I am Elvira, an endlessly curious kitty. I love to follow you around from room to room. I'll roll dramatically on the floor, sleep at the foot of your bed, and show off my playful side with lasers, strings, or bouncy balls. However, I usually prefer to admire you from afar. You can only pet me while I'm eating. But my quirky charm will quickly win you over. With patience—and Scraps showing me the joy of a good belly rub— I make strides in confidence every day.

Speaking of my BFF Scraps, we are a package deal! We love to wrestle, cuddle, chase, and we will absolutely entertain you. Together, we are the perfect combo of playful chaos and sweet companionship.

I am a "work-in-progress" cat. When I first came to Carmah, I was extremely shy but the volunteers saw possibilities in me. My foster and I have been making progress together. I want to find a home where I have the space and time to continue the process. When I first move to your home, I will probably hide while I get used to household rhythms, smells, sounds, and routines. I will slowly come out of my shell as I learn to trust you. I may always hide when new people arrive, or I might start to enjoy their company as well. I will reward your patience with loyalty and companionship.

We are 2 years old and in perfect health. If you’re ready for a pair of hilarious, lovable, belly-rub-seeking companion kitties who keep each other happy - and will keep you entertained, we are your duo!

Fees are:
Puppies 0 - 6 months $495
Puppies 6 - 12 months $450
Adult dogs $395
Senior dogs 8 years and over $195
Adult cats $150
Kittens $195 or $250 for a pair
Senior cats 8 years and over $95

Our adoption application is found and submitted through our website derryhumanesociety.com

Once an application is submitted, it will be sent to an adoption counselor who will reach out to you if you may be a good match.
